nom: Thayers Blemish Clearing Toner with 2% Salicylic Acid

avis.texte: The website does not update itself, but you are NOT receiving the blemish clear toner with just salicylic acid, you are receiving the formulation with 2% BH which feels like an entirely different product on the skin. The correct listing for this product would be "blemish clearing 2% BHA toner. It's been such a waste of my time picking up the wrong items at the store and then being sent the incorrect items. ULTA, UPDATE THIS LISTING FOR THE ACTUAL ITEM BEING SHOWN.
Literally the best clean face wash ive ever used, and the only thing that has cleared my acne!! The whole acne line is for sure a 100/10!!

I began using this about two months ago. On my first use, I suddenly started breaking out in large pimples, so I stopped using it. However, my best friend encouraged me to continue using it, and I did so. To my surprise, the large pimples dried up within days. After that, I noticed that I didn't break out again, even when I was eating the foods that usually caused me to break out. It smells great too FYI: I have a face that is very prone to acne/pimples. Over the years, I have used several toners, especially acne-clearing/prevention toners, but none of them have ever worked for me. I just use them for the sake of using toner even though none of them have been effective.

I mistook this toner for the regular unscented witch hazel and didn't think anything of it until the skin around my nose and mouth started peeling. You could especially see it under my makeup which i didnt love.

I am 42 with some hormonal acne. I just can never seem to get a clear face for the past few years. Once one giant blemish goes away two more pop up. I have tried so many products. This toner works and it works pretty fast. I saw a huge improvement within the first few days of use. I have been using it for about two weeks now and my face is clear.
Gret for clearing acne, as soon as I start feeling a pimple coming in I put this on throughout the day and the next day is gone.

I have oily sensitive acne prone combination skin, and while yes this got rid of some of my breakouts and shrunk my pores it BUUUUURRRRNNNNSSSS. On my skin and the vapors from my eyes, especially after taking a shower. Good product but not for me.

So I had been looking for a blemish clearing toner and I completely forgot about Thayers! I used to use them all the time for my toners but had stopped using toner for a while (just because I got lazy). I've been breaking out along my chin and jawline consistently, which is new and annoying for me and probably hormonal. I saw that this was constantly sold out on Ulta's website so I kept an eye on it and finally got my hands on it! I have not had a breakout on my chin or jawline since using this for the past week of 2 and it has to be the reason! Sooo happy, I hope this continues!
I love this toner, it is quickly absorbed by my skin. The scent is nice along with the ingredients. I like the size, the packaging, and it is affordable.
I've noticed that it's been helping keep my pores cleaner and dissolving anything therein. I like it. It smells good and works fine. I really liked it

This is great for toning after cleansing your face especially if you e done an exfoliant scrub; it helps to keep the pores minimized and sterile and to keep your ph balanced. It has a slight lemongrass scent.
If I were to use this product everyday my skin would dry out, I would say it's best to use a few times a few for better face results. The scent smells like lemongrass.
This toner meets my standards. The scent was clean. The toner has a nice finish to it leaving your skin glowing and fresh. The price point is very great and the ingredients are decent.
I enjoyed using the blemish cleaning toner I felt relief when my skin was irritated from pimples coming out. It helped reduce the pain and stop them from getting worse. Helped my skin clear up fast

I received this from Influenster for free in exchange for my honest review. This toner wasn't bad, but it's not my favorite. It's very drying, so I can't use it often, so it doesn't help with any acne that I have. I have combination skin that is acne prone, so I was excited to try this out. However it didn't work very well for me.
This product was effective at clearing up my skin after an outbreak. It kept my skin feeling clean and clear. It also helped keep skin feeling good after the breakout was over.

The toner smells amazing, it has a nice fresh scent. You get a lot of product and I love the bottle has a spout that allows control of the product. I used it on the acne I get from my menstrual cycle, and it helped greatly! A noticeable improvement in a few days.

I really like the lemongrass scent of this collection! It's a nice addition and is not overwhelming! The packaging is a nice fit in my drawer and the flip lid makes it easy to quickly squeeze this product on a cotton ball to use!

I really really like this toner. It does not contain alcohol so it is not harsh or drying like other acne toners. And it has such an amazing citrusy scent for not having any added fragrence.Also I have found that leave on SA products like this work better than SA washes that you just rinse right off. I think salicylic acid takes time to work so a product like this is much more effective.
This toner works well with any acne spot and blemish that occasionally appears. Dries it out quickly and efficiently. Not a fan of the scent but I can work with it
Very good at clearing acne. The whole system works together to clear acne and the best part is very affordable. I was given a sample in exchange for my feedback.
Best toner I've used to date. It doesn't have a strong smell but it definitely gets the job done. I would try to use it sparingly because a little goes a long way
After a period of using and experiencing this product, I feel it works quite well. My skin improved more than I expected. you are worth a try. pleasant fragrance. The box is quite sturdy. Thank

I really enjoyed this toner. It did not overly dry my skin, but it was effective with my breakouts. I love salicylic acid because it is gentle but effective for both my back breakouts and facial breakouts.

I'm so thankful I received the chance to review this product complimentary in exchange for my honest review! I love using this toner after I cleanse my skin with the cleanser because it makes my skin feel so clean and soft! I feel confident using this product that it will keep my mild acne away! It does have the same smell as the other products but that's only because of the witch hazel. I highly recommend trying this product!
Very nice! Great for a chemical exfoliant at night. Can burn a little bit. A little goes a long way! Scent is good, just more toner like. Packaging is nice too!

This toner is a game-changer! It's helped to balance my skin's pH and reduce the appearance of pores. The witch hazel and tea tree oil work wonders on my skin, and it's become a staple in my daily routine. 5/5 stars
This is a great toner with 91% naturally derived ingredients. It helps to clear acne and prevent new breakouts. It also has a nice soothing feeling. Highly recommended!
I really like the way this feels on my face. It doesn't leave a sticky feeling and leaves my skin feeling very nourished from the aloe vera. I really like to use this for my acne

Loved using this in the morning in place of a full face wash. The ingredients are all clean and natural so I felt good about the product and actually really enjoyed using it! I experience acne occasionally and with daily use I have noticed my skin clearing up!

The package is great the scent was fine. The ingredients seemed great but I broke out more after using this and I thought maybe my skin was purging old stuff but nope this stuff gave me more acne and bumps didn't work for me
This us a great blemish clearing toner, but this can leave your skin pretty dry so I don't use it so often. But overall is a great product and I recommend it.
Similar to the blemish clearing pads, I didn't notice much difference in my skin using this. I probably would not repurchase as I don't feel it added much benefit

I did use this for a month consistently, every other day so as not to dry my skin out too much. This was after two weeks, so I can't say it was super effective, but it definitely helped. I do feel like it made my skin redder after use. I wish the top was a little finer, it is somewhat easy to spill if not careful.

I really like the brand Thayers, but I think their hydrating line is a bit better for my skin type. This product 100% helped to clear my acne and minimize the breakouts I have, however my skin feels a bit tight after applying. It is not as drying as the pads however and I think the aloe vera helps with that. I do have very dry skin to begin with, so this may be more of an oily skin product. It definitely helped with my acne though and I would consider this a good affordable BHA toner!

Truth-be-told I'm very torn with this product. It was definitely effective but it was very drying on my skin! My large deep blemish went away faster than usual but my skin was VERY dry afterwords. So again, effective but very strong on my skin. Maybe worth a try? Especially if you get a lot of acne in a large area of the face

I was sent this to try from Influenster in exchange for my honest review and I must say I am very happy with the results of this toner, it removed all of the extra impurities from my skin after washing with the face wash. I found my skin to be super clean and hydrated. I loved how it added moisture back to my face leaving it with an even smooth look.
It is really effective. I like the scent and the packaging is so nice. The ingredients are just what I needed and it is worth the price. Thank you so much for this

This was one of my favorite products from the line. It soothed my skin and gave me a super clean feeling after washing my makeup off. It also didn't hurt that I loved the smell of it also. I'm definitely keeping this one in my skincare rotation.

Scent is pleasant and not too strong. I liked that this is alcohol free and has ingredients I already gravitate to when breaking out. I have really oily skin and this worked fine for me and thankfully didn't irritate my skin. But I'm not sure it was better than my usual toner. I'll probably keep using this whenever I break out while I still have product left.

This alcohol free toner has been great for my skin. And on top of the amazing results, it smells lovely! I'd actually heard really good things about this product but wasn't sure it would live up to the hype, especially since the price is super affordable. I was pleasantly surprised!

This is a decent toner. Compared to other toners I've used by this brand in the past, it seems exactly the same. It's a good toner - doesn't dry out the skin. But it doesn't seem to have any unique affect on my acne.

I received this product for free in exchange for an honest review. This product is great. I love the packaging. Thayers products have worked well for me so far. I have struggled with acne my whole life, and nothing ever seems to work for me. When I use these products consistently I can see a difference. They KEY is CONSISTENTLY. When I slack and don't use them, I notice my skin breaks out again.
Big bottle of toner! Helps with skin and acne, didn't add any additional breakouts, smells great and cleans well. Easy to use as well. Would recommend the whole bundle

avis.titre: A nice toner that didn't irritate my skin
avis.texte: Toners are my favorite step in my skincare routine. This felt nice on my skin and didn't leave it feeling dry or irritated. The price is similar to other brands so I would say it's worth it depending on your preference.
I'm not usually a toner in my skincare routine type of girl but this one is nice! I'll probably continue to use it to see how it works long term on my skin!

This toner has worked very well on my skin to reduce acne and breakouts. I love that is very gentle and actually feels refreshing on the skin. Many toners I have used are very harsh and drying so I was pleasantly surprised by how gentle yet effective this product was. My skin has shown progress in clearing from blemishes as shown in the photos. Overall, I was very happy with this product and how it has helped my skin without being too harsh.

I got this for free from influenster to try and I like it so much! I love the lemongrass scent and it leaves my face feeling so fresh. I do feel it leaves a bit of a residue to me and it did cause a small breakout with use at first. But overall a great toner and so great for summer!
This toner burned my face when applying. It left it very red and irritated. I have not and will not use it again. It could just be my skin, but I will stick to other toners.

After trying the toner it haves made me feel my skin more clear and cleaner and also moisturized and not alot of blemishes in face and the scent haves a hint of lemon and witch hazel and the ingredients feel so natural and the price it's affordable .

I love having toner as an extra step in my skin care, this did great as acting as sort of a double cleanse for my face and clearing up any small blemishes! price is amazing for the product and the scent is very nice as well! will definitely be purchasing in the future!

This was an okay product but I am not necessarily its biggest fan. I found it more drying than the other products in the line. I probably wouldn't buy it but I'll use the rest of the product if I find the need for it.
I love it, I used to use this brand before and for me worked perfectly, smells good and for the price is super convenient, I recommend this brand thx!

You need this in your life!! It works wonderfully! It works great on my combined skin. I used this every other day, and it made a lot of difference in my skin. It cleans my pores and prevents brakeouts!!

This feels so cooling and smells amazing. It is very easy to use and I like that it has witch hazel which is really good for redness and has greatly helped me balance skin issues in the past so it's a trusted ingredient for me. I will continue purchasing this as it is a household favorite.

I received this product complimentary from Thayers & Influenster for my honest review. I was so excited about this line as I love skin care that is gentle on the skin especially for someone with redness like myself I was looking forward to having a new fave. I was a bit disappointed though as this whole line seemed to be wayyy too drying for my skin. I found this product to smell really well but didn't really notice any good difference in my skin only more dryness than usual which I do not need flaky skin . I see this working better for someone without skin sensitivity and for someone with oil skin only not combo.

I enjoyed this product, but I think there was something wrong with the one I recieved. It wasn't fully clear, and had a cloudy white milkyness to it, which didn't match the ones I saw in stores so I wasn't comfortable continuing use.

I received this complimentary product in exchange for my honest review. I have used Thayers products before but am new to the Acne-Prone skin line. These pads contain witch hazel, salicylic acid, lemongrass, and aloe and claim to clear acne and prevent new breakouts. I thought the pads were drying on my dry skin, but I liked the ingredients and the price point seems to be reasonable. If you have combo or oily acne-prone skin, this may be a better product for you.

I swear this is a secret miracle product! Nothing has ever cleared up my skin like the lemongrass toner, even the other Thayers products break me out. I've tried normal salicylic acid, and other salicylic acid toners, and about a million other acne products - none work like this stuff. I wish I knew WHY after years of acne my skin is like "hm yes this is exactly what I needed, thank you", but I guess I'll take it lol.

I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. I'm not a huge fan of toners and I don't normally use them regularly. This one has a more pleasant scent than plain witch hazel which is a plus. This has been nice to add into my routine and it's been effective.
This toner is alcohol free & is formulated with tea tree oil, aloe vera, & witch hazel to soothe & hydrate your skin. A tiny drop on the affected area will clear your worst breakouts in no time!

This toner effectively targets blemishes and breakouts while balancing my skin's PH Levels. I've noticed a significant reduction in breakouts and blackheads since incorporating this toner into my regimen. This toner is soothing, and helps to calm my inflammation and redness, leaving my skin refreshed and revitalized. It is also free from harsh chemicals and artificial fragrances, making it duits le for sensitive skin types.
I actually already have this in the cucumber scent- but can't decide which one I like more! I have a lot of redness to my skin normally so this helps a lot. Doesn't dry out my skin personally.
I love lemongrass scent, it's so refreshing and good for the summer. Toner itself is also very gentle and good for everyday use bring calm to the skin. I will purchase it again and will recommend it
i live for a good toner and this one is good. it cleansed the skin without making it oily or dry. it had a typical toner scent kinda astringent-y but dissipates quick
This toner works so well I have another bottle of this exact toner bc I love it so much, it's exfoliates my skin and makes it feel so smooth. Only downside it kinda of stings but it works!

As someone who's struggled with blemishes, finding a toner that actually works has been a game-changer for me. This blemish clearing toner not only effectively reduces the appearance of blemishes but also helps prevent new ones from popping up. The light, refreshing scent is a bonus, making it a pleasure to use in my daily skincare routine. Plus, the packaging is sleek and convenient, perfect for travel or everyday use. With key ingredients like salicylic acid and tea tree oil, it's a powerhouse for targeting blemishes without drying out my skin. And considering its effectiveness, the price is surprisingly affordable, making it a must-have in my skincare arsenal.

I've never been one to use toner before, but wow! This stuff is great! It cut my skin from getting as red as it usually does and it's got a nice spend and the packaging I'm not a fan of. But you know it has quality ingredients and the price is adequate, so a lot of people will continue to get it.
This toner was such amazing quality, the scent was pleasing and for the price it almost feels like a high end toner! My sensitive skin did not react bad to this product neither!
I feel like this brand just doesn't suit my skin. I do have acne prone skin but this irritates my face and makes it feel super dry so I won't be using it anymore

Nice and fresh on the skin, did notice some redness in my skin tho so for sure apply sunscreen when using these products in my opinion. I didn't see a huge difference in acne prevention but will continue to try.

Obsessed with this toner it's all I use it cleanses my skin so good without over drying it as I have dry skin. The smell is a clean calm scent no irritation. I love using this to really deep clean my face after my face wash.
Been using this product for about a week and am finding that it keeps my skin from producing as much oil, which has helped keep blackheads (and the occasional breakout) in check!

avis.titre: Effective toner for sensitive skin and acne!
avis.texte: I absolutely love Thayers Blemish Clearing facial toner. This product contains LemonGrass, Aloe and Salicylic Acid. I also suggest using this once a day and then gradually going up to 3 times a day. This routine is absolutely fantastic. This toner makes skin firm while clearing blemishes. I love the scent of the LemonGrass. Previously I used Thayers Rose toner and now I prefer the Blemish Clearning toner a thousand times more. It causes zero irritation and truly makes a difference on my acne. I highly recommend this to anyone!
This toner leaves my face feeling clean. It smells lemony clean. It removes all oils and dirt from my face leaving my face feeling smooth. This bottle will last for a good while.

Products with natural ingredients are my favorites and these are undoubtedly the best. This tonic, apart from having a phenomenal fragrance, fulfills its function, it dries out the skin a little but it is effective in drying out those unwanted pimples. I also recommend it for its price. It's super great, its packaging is great and comfortable because you don't lose product, you use what you need

This toner smelled absolutely amazing! I haven't used very many toners but I loved the way my face felt after using it and I loved the lemony scent to it! Overall I was impressed with this product, and may incorporate this into my everyday skincare routine!

I received this product for free from Influencer and Thayers in exchange for my honest review. (Incentive). My teenage son struggles really bad with acne. I was hoping this product would help some but unfortunately after over a month of using we seen no improvement. The pictures shown are about a month and a half of using the product. I didn't notice any strong smells and his skin didn't have any irritation to the product unfortunately it didn't work. I wouldn't recommend this product based on how we seen no improvements.

First thing I'd ever tried from Thayers was their Rose toner. I LOVED it. This one is great too. I prefer the scent of the rose one, but this isn't a bad scent. It works well! It amazes me that when I use this after work, just how much stuff gets on your face throughout the day. This toner helps remove all the dirt and grime from your face. It's perfect for summer because it feels refreshing and doesn't make your skin feel tight or dry. Also, no adverse skin reactions! All in all, great product.
This toner is awesome! It has a lemongrass scent which is pleasant and not too overwhelming. The is easy to open and the toner comes out easily. It leaves your skin feeling clean and fresh!

I received this item for free from Influenster and Thayers in exchange for my honest review. Gentle toner, swipes everything off the face. Gentle enough to use everyday. It's packaging is very simple and easy to understand. Overall I really like the simplicity of this product.

I'm always on the hunt for a moisturizing toner that won't break me out, and this has the right ingredienta to soothe and hydrate while preventing acne. This formula that never leaves my skin feeling stripped. It does, however, effectively remove oils from places cleansing tends to miss, like the hairline and around my ears. A little bit goes a long way, and with a large bottle, this is a great value. It complements an active-laden routine well, as it's gentle enough to avoid irritating skin even with daily use.

Absolute must! Summer days are pretty much here! Ugh who wants an oily face when it's already hot! . Product is great to help control oily face that causes break outs and built upZ great in sensitive skin. Definitely recommend
I feel like this works well and will get the job done. I don't really care for the scent of it. Over time it may make your skin more dry. For the price point though it's not bad.

I was gifted the Thayers Blemish clearing toner and I've really enjoyed them! A good toner is essential in my skincare routine and this is very effective at treating my breakouts and fading my acne scaring. The scent was also fairly pleasant.This is a great affordable option.

This toner helps get in deep to the pores to control acne the nice thing about it is there is good ingredients like aloe to and lemongrass to help sooth the skin also it helps remove oil,sweat and dirt there is no alcohol and no added fragrance it has 2% salicylic its said that results will be within 1 week I started to noticed around the second week of using this toner that's my skin was feeling refreshed and renewed also I noticed is very tough on acne but soft on skin and it didn't dry me out at all also you can use it for acne on back or around the butt acne if you have stubborn acne there it also helps take off with white heads and black heads and preventing new break outs to happen great for all skin types it's dermatologist tested and approved it doesn't burn when I applied it like some toners do the scent is very light and definitely works and does what it's promised to do super happy I was able to try this product out loved it

The toner contains 2% salicylic acid, so I ended up concentrating my application to the areas of my face that have pimples/blemishes. I appreciate that it is alcohol-free!! Overall, it works great and the bottle contains a lot of product.
After I'm done cleaning my face, I start using these to try up any of my pimples! The smell isn't bad and the packaging is alright! Would buy this in the future
The clearing toner wasn't too heavy and the smell wasnt over powering. Im a toner girl and this didnt dry me out like most toners. I highly recommend to use with this package.
This toner is the best. I love how easy it is to get product onto my cotton pad or hands. As an acne-prone girl, this toner has helped my skin with blemishes. I would repurchase this for sure

avis.titre: Price points is really good and good for active acne
avis.texte: I was sent this product in exchange for my honest review. This product I would recommend as I saw more of a difference when I used it specifically over active acne. It wasn't drying at all for me and it smells really nice. The price point for this is awesome and great for those who are starting out. ￼

Thank you, influencer and Thayers for sending me the Thayers blemish clearing 2% salicylic acid facial toner, lemongrass, complementarily free for testing purposes. This toner is great to use one time out of the week The reason why I say one time a week is because witch hazel is known to cause allergies on skin and irritation so using it one time a week will help to keep your skin clear from acne and actually this will helps exfoliate the skin as well. I recommend applying with your hands or a cotton pad leave on your skin for about 30 seconds to a minute then rinse off and cleanse and moisturize your skin right after don't leave it on.
This toner is refreshing as has been a great step to my routine. After washing my face this toner helps my skin feel cool and refreshed. It smells good on top of that.
Makes your skin feel fresh an clean after a long day of wearing make up / working out / just living life. It effectively clears everything all imperfections

It seems similar to blemish pads. It gets the job done and clear up any blemishes. The price is reasonably for the amount of the product. Good scent and packaging is nice and cap stays shut. I recommend it.
I like this toner, it's perfect for my anti acne routine. It's awesome that it contains 91% of natural ingredients and it's also alcohol free! It's very gentle on my skin and helps combating acne.

I received this product free from Influenster in exchange for an honest review. To start off, this product smells amazing! I love how soothing it was to apply it and how it didn't leave my skin feeling sticky or heavy after which a lot of toners have done in the past. I like to use this product after I cleanse my face and I alternate between this toner and the pads depending how my skin wakes up feeling.

First off, I really love the lemongrass scent. A lot of other toners have a strong alcohol scent, and this one is very fresh. I have sensitive skin and did not have any reaction besides normal drying that I experience with every toner. It was great to dry out any pimples, and a nice step in my new Thayer's routine.

I like this toner very much. This line works amazingly well. I have been using it on my face and back (my biggest problem area) and it's been working quite well. My breakouts have been almost completely eliminated. Too bad I didn't do before and after pictures. I enjoy the smell of this line as well.

Some people don't think toners are necessary but this one is a treatment toner, loaded with salicylic acid to smooth skin and clear blemishes and acne breakouts. I use only a couple times of week as an exfoliating to help diminish the look of big pores and it definitely does the job! A little drying but I always just add extra moisture to my skin after using. My boyfriend loves it too so that's a plus! You're getting a lot for your $ with this toner as well. Overall good toner.
I like using this to clean my face before bed. It smells decent, looks decent, and makes my face feel clean. I just wish it did more about my acne. Overall, not bad.
The blemish cleaning toner by thayers is a great product for your self care routine! The scent is a strong scent but the price is a great price to buy!
It's not bad it was effective and I am okay with the scent, the packaging was good and my skin haven't flared up yet so so far so good and I totally recommend it
I was scared at first to use it because i'm really sensitive with toners and plus it has the same smell as the pads but it does its job and hasn't broken me out
It works pretty well, I tried it for a few weeks but I still prefer my rose water toner. I have no complaints about it at all, though. Definitely does the job!

THAYERS Lemon Astringent is like a tall glass of lemonade for your skin. PH balanced, and gentle, non-drying. The toner formula imparts a natural glow to the skin. Love that is alcohol free and does not dry my face after each use.

I love using this toner! It has a nice calming sensation to my acne prone irritated sensitive skin. I also have the blemish pads so I'll keep them on like a mask and will use the toner to rehydrate them.

I normally use glycolic acid as my pm toner and just a facial essence spray for my am. This product has always scared me so I was excited to have the opportunity to try it. You can use it for am or pm toning. Clean ingredients. Smells so refreshing.

avis.titre: An amazing toner for acne treatment.
avis.texte: To start the smell is absolutely lovely! And it leaves your face nice and fresh. A small amount on a cotton ball or rag goes a long way on your face. And it really seems to help clear everything up.
It's okay I'm not in love with it but I will continue to use it. It's not my most favorite toner I've used but it works. I do have sensitive skin and I haven't had any issues. Smells like lemon
This is effective. I like that you get a lot of product for less, this is best applied with a cotton ball but I use a reusable cotton round. it has a mild scent.

avis.titre: Great product, great scent, great company
avis.texte: Let's start by stating that there does not exist a miracle toner that will solve all your problems. In my situation, most makes things worse, however the Thayers clearing toner seems to contain my acne breakouts. Now, I have been using this as a set, so it is hard to determine if a single product is the cause, but my skin feels fresh and clean after each use. The packaging is quite nice as it is easy to use and does not leak. Solid product. Also the lemongrass leaves a nice hint which is very pleasant.

avis.titre: It's ok, I don't see results acne wise
avis.texte: I have mild to severe acne, so my reason for using toner is to help clear my skin. Now, I've used Thayer's for a length of time in the past, and I've used a few of the different variations of the toners, and I felt that they never really cleared up my skin. Being able to try this toner again I still didn't see good results. I don't feel it works on my skin. ￼

avis.titre: It's okay, Not Much to Say
avis.texte: This product was okay. I don't really have an opinion on it, other than when used in conjunction with other Thayer's products, it seemed to be effective in doing it's job.

I love the original thayers scent but this one has lemon grass in it to cover up the scent of the witch hazel. The smell is very strong and strong fragrance are not good for the skin on your face. I would like it if it smelled more like real lemongrass.
This was really nice to use, I am still. Using it and I essentially just love the feeling of this toner. I did find that some of the ingredients accumulate at the bottom so u like to shake it first.

I was using this product with the other thayer skin care I got from influenster so it's hard to say 100% if this product was effective or not. It felt nice in the skin and it was gentle. I always use my corax toner and honestly they're not to different from each other. Will definitely continue using.
I'm such a fan of this line by Thayers. The toner is refreshing, effective in an extra cleanse, and non drying. It's cost effective too! It smells refreshing. I will be buying again once I finish it.

avis.titre: Evens out skin tone and texture
avis.texte: I was very happy with this toner. After using it, I felt like my skin tone and texture evened out. It also did not dry out my skin a ton like other toners have. There isn't much of a sent which I like because sometimes they can be too strong.

I absolutely love that it is lemongrass scented. Not only does it have a rephreshing scent but the other ingredients are natural as well. The witch hazel helps tone and tighten your pores while also providing a wonderful cleansing feeling. I will say compared to the abrasiveness of the pads, this toner allows you to use it on any type of pad you wish. I prefer to use it with a microfiber cloth. I absolutely love it. I highly recommend
I love this toner! It leaves my skin feeling refreshed and it smells fantastic. The ingredients are good for my skin. The price is right and the packaging looks clean.
I genuinely like this product a lot it works very well. Love the packaging it's super easy to use. I will definitely be repurchasing when I run out.
